title: End of the copying pass
statement: For every binary input $x$, output word $o$, and syntax-scanner state $q$, the dual transducer run from the copying state carrying $q$ at position $|x|+1$ with output $o$ reaches after one step the rewind state with its flag true at position $|x|$, still with output $o$. The anchor state is not visited during this one-step segment.
replaced:
For every input $x$, output word $o$, and formula-scanner state $q$, the configuration
reached by one step of the dual transducer from the copying state carrying $q$ at the
right boundary position $|x| + 1$ with output $o$ is the rewind state with flag true
at position $|x|$ with output still $o$, and the anchor state is not visited.
